title: Stop Saying "Very Slow"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very slow". Use one of these words instead:
• Sluggish: a sluggish start
• Plodding: a plodding film
• Leisurely: a leisurely stroll
• Snail-paced: snail-paced traffic
• Glacial: at a glacial pace

Comment your own word for "very slow"!
